regional_compliance.tax_context: Standard federal and state income/payroll tax; many practices structure as S-corps or PLLCs for tax treatment of owner compensation.
regional_compliance.labor_regulation: Standard federal/state employment law; HIPAA compliance applies to all patient data handling and is a major operational/compliance cost.
regional_compliance.licensing_bodies: State medical/dental board licensure for providers, DEA registration if prescribing controlled substances, CLIA certification if performing lab testing in-office.

humanity_mode_regional_addendum.0_percent: HIPAA compliance cost as a fixed overhead, state-by-state insurance credentialing timelines, multi-payer reimbursement rate variance.

learning_objectives: Understand HIPAA compliance as a significant, ongoing operational cost rather than a one-time setup task.
Analyze how the US multi-payer insurance system creates reimbursement rate variance that a single-payer system would not.
